rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Maya

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hey, Marcus here. You've got about twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks, Marcus. A fintech peer shortened ramp using HyperSale’s realistic AI buyer practice and quote-backed scoring. Is reducing Ledgerline’s seven-month ramp the priority?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes—that’s time to first closed deal. How does the buyer practice actually work for technical integration questions?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Reps roleplay realistic buyers handling technical questions, then managers get scores with exact supporting quotes and week-over-week progress. Does that sound useful?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Potentially, but that’s still broad. How does it learn our actual integrations and determine whether a rep’s answer is technically correct, rather than just confident?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: It simulates realistic buyer objections and scores every response with exact quote evidence, so managers can verify performance instead of trusting confidence. Useful?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Not yet. You still haven’t explained how it learns our integrations or who defines the technically correct answer—do we upload documentation, and how are updates and hallucinations handled?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I don’t want to overstate the setup without our technical team; quote-backed scoring lets managers verify answers. Should we explore a pilot?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: No. Before a pilot, I need your technical team to explain knowledge ingestion, answer validation, updates, hallucination controls, and data handling—our customer-call transcripts are sensitive.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Absolutely. I’ll bring in our technical team to cover ingestion, validation, updates, hallucinations, and data handling; would sometime next week work?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Rachel owns this, not me, so she’ll need to be there. Propose a specific 30-minute slot next week with those technical topics on the agenda, including transcript retention, encryption, access controls, and model-training use.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: How about Tuesday at 2 p.m. Eastern for 30 minutes with Rachel and our technical lead? I’ll put every requested topic on the agenda.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Tuesday at 2 Eastern works. Send Rachel and me the invite with that agenda and your technical lead included. Okay, I need to jump to standup.
